Olivia: Posting follow-up from Cust-Iris Dedicated postmortem. Root cause: intermittent VPC peering route churn + on-prem NAT conntrack exhaustion causing worker isolation. Short actions below.

Raj: Owners + ETAs? Is this a recurring pattern?

Marta: Pattern: yes — we've seen similar peering+conntrack interactions during control-plane churn. Lab logs show `nf_conntrack: table full` when we replay short-lived client bursts.

Raj: I'll own peering fallback and monitoring (ETA 48h). Marta, you own on-prem repro + sizing guidance (ETA 7 days). Emma take CS comms & SLA notes (ETA 4h).

Olivia: Short-term mitigations to apply now: enable regional fallback flag (ETA 2h), tune gateway keepalives to 15s (ETA 1h), add conntrack >75% alert (ETA 6h).

DeployBot: Created tickets INC-57001, REM-57002, CS-57003. https://jira.redwood/INC-57001

Emma: Draft to customer: "We've applied temporary routing failovers and are working on a permanent mitigation. We'll provide a detailed timeline within 5 business days." Please review.

Marta: Repro snippet for runbook: `for i in {1..350}; do timeout 1 bash -c "</dev/tcp/${PEER_IP}/$((1024 + i % 2000))" & done; sleep 2; dmesg | tail -n 40 | grep conntrack`

Raj: Also adding a cross-customer task: correlate peering BGP flaps with control-plane deploy windows for last 180 days. Owner: Raj, ETA 2025-06-01.

Olivia: Add anything missing to the Jira tickets and we'll review in next week's peering cadence slot. Escalate on #eng-oncall if needed. Closing after cadence notes posted.
